items.title: Lost in tokenization: Does the AI revolution treat Turkish speakers differently?
items.author: Zehra Unlu
items.excerpt: Ask a chatbot the same question in English and in Turkish, and the answers may look alike. What happens behind the screen does not. Before an artificial intelligence (AI) model can understand any text, it breaks it into tiny fragments, and languages are not all split the same way. Consider one sentence: "Apparently they will not be able to get out of our houses." In Turkish, it is just two words: "Evlerimizden cikamayacaklarmis." Thousands have gathered to admire, connect with and collect works from across the world.
